description: This PHP source file defines the ModulesLib class, which provides methods for handling module record retrieval, pagination, sorting, and user information within the SuiteCRM API v8 library. It interacts with SugarCRM beans, filters, and API resources.

classes.name: ModulesLib
classes.description: A class providing API methods for retrieving and paginating module records, handling sorting, filtering, and user info within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: generatePaginatedModuleRecords
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of module records, applying filters, sorting, and field selection, and formats the response with links.

methods.name: generatePaginatedLinksFromModuleRecords
methods.description: Generates pagination links (self, first, last, prev, next) based on current pagination state and request parameters.

methods.name: getSorting
methods.description: Processes the 'sort' request parameter to generate an SQL ORDER BY clause.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of module records from the database, applying filters, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: generatePaginationUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL for pagination links with given offset, limit, filters, sorting, and fields.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on OAuth user ID from the request.
